title: Engineering Manager
summary: Engineering leader with 10 years of experience in software development and 3 years managing cross-functional teams of 8-12 engineers. Delivered a platform migration that reduced operational costs by $1.2M annually and built two high-performing teams from scratch.

responsibilities: Managed a team of 10 engineers across 3 squads delivering the core payments platform
Drove migration from on-premise infrastructure to AWS, reducing annual infrastructure spend by $1.2M
Established quarterly OKR process and engineering scorecards adopted across 4 product teams
Hired and onboarded 6 engineers in 12 months, growing the team from 4 to 10
Designed and implemented a Kafka-based event streaming pipeline processing 5 million transactions per day
Led a 4-engineer team to rebuild the payment reconciliation engine, cutting nightly batch processing time by 60%
Mentored 3 mid-level engineers and conducted structured performance reviews
Built microservices for a construction project management SaaS platform in Java and Spring Boot
Developed an ETL pipeline ingesting data from 8 third-party APIs into a central data warehouse
